BIMcollab

BIMcollab Zoom

BIMcollab Zoom provides model viewing, smart issue workflows and rule-based BIM validation.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Explore a federated model

Begin with the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended BIMcollab Zoom preview, explore a federated model; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Run a smart-view check

Use the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended BIMcollab Zoom preview, run a smart-view check; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Publish a coordination issue

Start from the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended BIMcollab Zoom preview, publish a coordination issue; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
